This page (netflixaccountupdate.com) is not the official Netflix domain and appears to be a phishing page asking for payment updates. I captured a screenshot for evidence, and will follow the safe link labeled "I'll update billing directly on Netflix.com" so you can update payment on the official Netflix site instead of entering sensitive payment info on this suspicious page. I recommend not entering any personal or payment information here, reporting the phishing email to Gmail, marking it as spam/phishing, and navigating directly to https://www.netflix.com via a new browser tab to update billing. If you already entered payment or password on the suspicious site, consider changing your Netflix and email passwords and contacting your bank to monitor the card.
